key_insight: Vibrational entropy changes the predicted stability ranking of cation arrangements in monolayer (MoWNbTaV)S₂, while vibrational spectra provide fingerprints for distinguishing them.
engineering_relevance: A DFT-trained machine-learning potential enables larger-scale screening of atomic arrangements in two-dimensional high-entropy materials.
method: Train a Gaussian approximation potential on DFT data through iterative learning.
Calculate Gibbs free energies and test thermal stability with molecular dynamics.
Predict Raman and infrared spectra to identify cation arrangements.
evidence_signal: Five selected configurations retained their trigonal-prismatic framework during nanosecond molecular dynamics at temperatures up to 1300 K.
watch_item: The predicted arrangements and spectral fingerprints require experimental validation; nanosecond stability does not establish long-term stability or synthesis outcomes.
paper_title: Prediction and characterisation of cation topology of pentanary high-entropy alloy (MoWNbTaV)S$_2$
